analysis.title: Lowe's Cos. (LOW): First Take: 3Q26 beat; FY26 sales and comp guidance raised
key_insights: LOW reported 3Q26 adj. EPS of $3.10, including a $0.34 benefit from tariff refunds, vs GS estimate $2.86 and FactSet consensus $2.88. Excluding the refund benefit, EPS would be about $2.76.
Adj. EPS of $3.10 excludes $96mn of pre-tax acquisition-related intangible amortization for FBM and ADG.

Net sales rose 9.3% y/y to $22.756bn vs GS $22.525bn and consensus $22.394bn. Comparable sales rose 1.8% y/y vs GS +0.0% and consensus +0.1%, driven by Pro, home services and 17.4% y/y online sales growth.

Adj. operating margin fell 80bps y/y to 11.7%, above GS 11.5% and consensus 11.4%. Gross margin fell 125bps y/y to 32.9%, in line with GS 32.9% and below consensus 33.1%. SG&A and D&A fell 44bps y/y as a share of sales to 21.2%.

FY26 guidance: sales $92.5bn (prior $92bn, consensus $92bn), comparable sales about +0.5% (prior flat, consensus +0.1%), adj. operating margin 11.5% (prior 11.6%, consensus 11.6%), adj. EPS about $12.25 (unchanged, consensus $12.27). Net interest expense $1.5bn (prior $1.6bn), capex up to $2.5bn.
Inventory rose 6.6% y/y to $18.3bn vs 9.3% sales growth. Payables ratio rose to 60.1% from 59.6%.

LOW traded slightly down pre-market. GS will look on the call for quarter-to-date trends, DIY demand, big-ticket and discretionary categories, Pro backlogs, inventory, PPI initiatives, detail on the recently closed acquisition, tariff refunds and the FY26 and FY27 outlook.
GS rates LOW Buy with a 12-month price target of $270, based on relative P/E multiples of 80%/90%/95% for downside/base/upside cases. Price was $220.46 at the 17 Nov close, implying 22.5% upside.

market_movers.rationale: First Take after a 3Q26 beat on EPS, sales and comparable sales, with FY26 sales and comp guidance raised. Margin guidance was trimmed and EPS guidance held. The $270 target is unchanged from the 19-Aug-26 target.

earnings_insights: LOW 3Q26 adj. EPS $3.10 reported 11/18 (includes $0.34 tariff refund benefit, excludes $96mn pre-tax acquisition amortization) vs GS est $2.86 and FactSet consensus est $2.88. 3Q25 adj. EPS was $3.06.
3Q26 net sales $22.756bn reported (+9.3% y/y) vs GS est $22.525bn and consensus est $22.394bn. Comparable sales +1.8% vs GS est +0.0% and consensus est +0.1%.
3Q26 operating profit $2,671mn (+2.3% y/y) vs GS est $2,581mn and consensus est $2,553mn. Adj. operating margin 11.7% vs GS est 11.5% and consensus est 11.4%.
3Q26 gross margin 32.9% (-125bps y/y) vs GS est 32.9% and consensus est 33.1%.

FY26 guidance (company): sales $92.5bn vs prior $92bn, comparable sales about +0.5% vs prior flat, adj. operating margin 11.5% vs prior 11.6%, adj. EPS about $12.25 unchanged. Consensus before the guide: sales $92bn, comps +0.1%, margin 11.6%, EPS $12.27.
GS estimates: 4Q (1/27E) EPS $1.96, FY1/27E EPS $12.14, FY1/28E EPS $12.88, FY1/29E EPS $13.85, FY1/27E revenue $92,205mn.
risk_factors: Comparable sales could slow if housing turnover fails to recover or macro conditions weigh on home improvement demand.
Increased competition or softer demand could hurt pricing and profitability.
